```{=html}
<div class="disclaimer">
  <p>Note: These documents were produced as coursework assignments for a coastal policy course at the Bren School of Environmental Science and Management, UC Santa Barbara, Fall 2025. They are shared here as writing samples and are not intended for official use or distribution, although the public comment letter was submitted to CCC ahead of a hearing.</p>
</div>
```

These two documents were written for a coastal policy course at Bren. The policy memo addresses climate-adaptive septic infrastructure in Bolinas, CA. The public comment letter was submitted to the California Coastal Commission ahead of a December 2025 hearing on a wave-powered desalination pilot in Fort Bragg, CA.

::: {.panel-tabset}
